definitions.explanation: A count of six people, using the Sino-Japanese number {六|ろく} with the counter {人|にん}. Note that {六|ろく} keeps its full form here — there is no small-tsu change as in {六本|ろっぽん} or {六個|ろっこ}.

examples.english: Six of us will stay the night.

examples.japanese: この{部屋|へや}には{六人|ろくにん}まで{入|はい}れます。
examples.english: Up to six people can fit in this room.

examples.japanese: {委員会|いいんかい}は{六人|ろくにん}の{委員|いいん}で{構成|こうせい}され、{月|つき}に{一度|いちど}{開|ひら}かれる。
examples.english: The committee is made up of six members and meets once a month.

notes:
{六|ろく} plus the counter {人|にん} for people.

WHICH READING:
ろくにん only. Many counters turn {六|ろく} into ろっ ({六本|ろっぽん}, {六階|ろっかい}, {六匹|ろっぴき}), but {人|にん} is not one of them.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {六人|ろくにん}で: as a group of six
- {六人|ろくにん}{家族|かぞく}: a family of six
- {六人|ろくにん}{掛|が}けのソファ: a six-seater sofa

RELATED COUNTS:
- {五人|ごにん}: five people
- {七人|しちにん}: seven people
